item.title: On the field at the Field of Ares, Hermos #21 and Ktegenes #61 the Twice-Born saw each oth
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares, Hermos #21 and Ktegenes #61 the Twice-Born saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 119 were spared.

item.title: Kallope #5577 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)).
item.description: Kallope #5577 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
